content.value: Each workstation has a maximum availability of 480 minutes per day. However, the workstations require daily maintenance, which amount to 10%, 14% and 12% of the 480 minutes daily availability for stations 1,2 and 3 respectively. The company wishes to determine the daily units to be assembled of $\mathrm { H } _ { \mathrm { i } } \mathrm { F } _ { \mathrm { i } } { - } 1$ and $\mathrm { H } _ { \mathrm { i } } \mathrm { F } _ { \mathrm { i } ^ { - 2 } }$ to minimize the sum of unused (idle) times at all three workstations.
